question: What act is forbidden for one holding a full vessel in the middle of the circle?
premises: The person holds a vessel in hand
The location is the middle of the circle
Bowing while holding a full vessel is negated
inference: One holding a full vessel in the middle of the circle should not bow.
uncertainties: The syntactic role of pūrṇa+pātrakam alongside pātra+hastaḥ is slightly compressed.
plain_english: Holding a vessel in hand in the middle of the circle, one should not bow with a full vessel.
